ryans.name: Ryan Breslow
ryans.title: Co-founder and CEO of Bolt
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Breslow** is an American entrepreneur and co-founder of **Bolt**, a checkout and payments software company for online retailers. After stepping down as CEO in early 2022 amid controversy, he was reinstated as CEO in March 2025 [1][3].
known_for: Bolt's 2022 valuation peak and later crash
